title: Favorite bands: Hines, Lefty Bates and Joe Kelly

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Of all the bands you played with, what was your favorite?

Well, my real favorite band, big band, was the Earl Fatha Hines. And my little band was Lefty Bates band, until I joined Joe Kelly. And after John Board started with Joe Kelly, then we really got together on, you know, different arrangements, and suggestions from Johnny Board. He really brought the band out. He would swing, all together different sound. We sounded like a 16-piece band.
Yeah, I know. He's got a good sound. You liked the more arranged groups, rather than the loose --
Yeah. Even if they were head arrangements, I liked it.
Did you get involved in a little arranging again at that time?
No, I never arranged any more music, after Earl, that I can remember. After I switched to the little bands, then I stopped arranging.
So you like the Lefty Bates' group, and Joe's?
Yeah, and Joe Kelly. Them two were the greatest sounding little bands I ever worked with.
Things were worked out in both groups?
